title: The Bedtime Deal
can_do: 主动提出“如果我做……能不能……”的交换条件，并接受合理条款。

conversation_move.label: offer a trade with if and accept fair terms

trigger: Bedtime is near and Child wants two books, so he offers something in return.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Bedtime is in ten minutes, sweetheart.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Mom, if I clean my blocks fast, can we read two books?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Two books is a lot for one night.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: But I'll brush my teeth without a reminder.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Hmm, that would help my evening a lot.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: So is it a deal? Blocks, teeth, two books?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Deal, if the blocks are away by seven.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Watch me zoom! Fastest cleanup tonight!

replay_cards.title: The morning trade
replay_cards.setting: A rushed morning, shoes still to put on.
replay_cards.change: Child wants one more cartoon before leaving.
replay_cards.challenge: Child offers to dress super fast first; Mom agrees to one short episode after he is ready.

replay_cards.title: The park trade
replay_cards.change: Child is still digging a tunnel.
replay_cards.challenge: Child offers to carry the bag home in exchange for five more minutes of digging, and both keep the deal.

parent_support: 孩子提交换条件时认真谈判：可以还价，但别一口否决。
成交后严格履约，让孩子体验“条件换来的”比“讨来的”更牢靠。
加一句复述：“我们的约定是什么？”让他完整说一遍条款。
